company_info.company_description: "Founded in 2014, Solarbank is proud to have built its business on providing quality solar power installations with a personalised service.Our business has the expertise of a large company, but with the personal touch and attention to detail of a smaller business. We are solar installers with a deep commitment to delivering value to our customers:Friendly and honest advice to suit your individual business or residential circumstances.The highest quality solar panels, batteries and inverters – we don’t use cheap components.Proven brands, which we guarantee to support into the future.Professional installers, who deliver the highest standards of workmanship and customer satisfaction.Competitive pricing of premium solar power systems.Industry leading after sales support."

reviews.review_description: From start to finish our experience with Solarbank was first rate. Janice was incredibly knowledgeable and always available to answer my questions. The installation team were careful, efficient and delivered a quality product. No hesitation in recommending the Solarbank team.

David from Solarbank was one of the few installers that came round to see the house to inspect it, listen to our needs and discuss options. I spent a lot of time researching what I wanted and David was very helpful in that process. He was then very patient, answered all my questions (which was many) and helped me through my strata issues.The install went well, I did have one issue 4 days after the installed and David was round asap to sort it out; not great there was an issue but these things happen, what was important was how it was dealt with and I’m really happy with the outcome.
A great experience. Responsive, quality installation, competitive price.Left the property clean and neat. Good follow up to subsequent questions. V.Happy.

Solarbank Australia (Andrew Moderer) provided excellent service from start to finish.  Unlike some other suppliers, they made an onsite visit to understand our needs, electricity supply and possible locations for inverter and battery.  Their recommended inverter and battery combination was designed to suit our home's 3 phase power supply (unlike some others who ignored this fact and quoted on less-than-ideal hardware).  The large battery recommended (19.32kWh) suits our household size and powers our ducted aircon for many hours.  Installation was on the agreed date and done professionally by a team of 6 in around 6 hours.  All installation has been done carefully and well.

The sales and quoting aspect was professional and answered all my question with real world answers not just theoretical ones. The installers were quick (but not rushed) and did an excellent job (I come from a trades background and know a good job when I see one), they answered my questions during the installation happily and without hesitation. Cleaned up after themselves.I would whole heartedly recommend them..

Solarbank are incredibly professional. They provide excellent education so you can make an informed decision. They are punctual. Their team are extremely polite. They took great care on our 100 year old home. We were so pleased. We love our solar, battery and car charger. I highly recommend this company.
The installation went very smoothly, highly professional job and customer service. I recommend Solarbank to anyone!

Solarbank provided excellent service from the first contact.  They reached out in a timely manner to my inquiry, were always responsive with a real person at the end of the phone who was knowledgeable and had the authority to organise everything from the first phone call.  I was able to deal with just two people, the primary sales person and the electrician who did the actual installation, no being passed around different office people.They did a site visit before preparing the final quote, which gave me confidence in the final quote (I live in strata). They were happy and quick to prepare different quotes for different sized batteries.They were very honest about their limited experience installing the particular battery I installed (Sigenergy), which I appreciated.On the day of the installation, they arrived on time, were polite and left the work area as tidy as they found it.  Follow-up has been excellent.I'm happy to recommend.

George from Solarbank was the only salesperson who took the time to visit personally. His price was flexible, and his communication was timely.Tradesmen arrived on time. Did a nice tidy job and were polite and friendly.
Prompt, efficient, friendly quote process.  Seamless installation with good admin support.  Excellent customer service - a pleasure to deal with. Highly recommended.

Jordon was one of the only installers who bothered to do a site visit, really take the time to understand my usage patterns and needs, and not just to try and push the most expensive system on me.  Installation was great, with only a few very minor areas that my OCD latched onto that were promptly addressed by the team. Very happy with the service, peace of mind and pre and post install support, 100% recommend the team.

Solarbank was prompt to respond to my battery needs. The company sent a representative who explained the best solution for a retrofit installation. The sales process was straightforward.The installers were on time, polite and tidied the site after the job was completed.However later in the day I discovered that the Powerwall 2 location was too low to the ground with risk of flooding from next door.I raised the oversight with management, the next morning, the electricians came back and relocated the Powerwall unit further up on the wall clear of any future weather events. Job well done! And great customer service!

I can’t speak highly enough of Andrew and the SolarBank team. No question was too big or small and I felt confident we were making the right decisions before we went ahead. The day of install was superbly run with superb attention to detail and a great crew. We’ve now got an absolutely fantastic system that looks really great. Couldn’t be happier. Thank you Andrew and team!
I appreciated the wonderful customer service from initial consultation, follow up questions, and prompt scheduling of installation and commissioning.

Enjoyed working with Andrew from Solarbank. I never felt like he was trying to sell me a product that wasn't exactly what I needed based on my roof. Other quotes seemed to differ there!The installation was quick and seamless. The team was professional, on time to the minute and respectful.Would recommend.

Had a great experience with Solarbank.Highly professional from start to finish.Solarbank understand the need to build customer trust and genuinely wanted to get the best result.Installation team were also excellent.

Quoting process was seamless. Whilst the quote wasn't the most competitive, I felt very confident in Solarbank's reputation as solar installer. Being a local business also swayed my decision to choose Solarbank.Installation Manager David was extremely professional and ensured I was kept up to date during the installation process. Site was expertly managed during the installation process and was left extremely tidy and clean, compared to usual tradesmen.Highly recommend this business

From the time that Andrew made the assessment for a PV system with battery, through to the proposal, the timing of the installation, the very competent installation team, the operation of the system (Fronius/BYD), and the timely response of Solarbank (phone and email) to questions - this has been a very smooth and professional process.  Have no hesitation in recommending Solarbank.
Good Job. Good team. Good install.  David is a good communicator

Very professional, polite and punctual for the whole process. Very happy with the fantastic installation. I asked about a shuffle around of the panels to different positions and it was not a problem. Cabling was hidden in cavity, so a very neat installation.

We had the solar system installed last Nov and already seeing savings with our bills. When we moved in to our new house, I found the winter bills to be astronomical so I was looking for a fast solution. This system is good quality, they self clean, tilted for maximum benefit and Andrew has been a pleasure to deal with. I would definitely recommend.

The sales and quoting system was very good. The team responded very quickly with a quote and then when we changed the specs we wanted they responded very quickly. The installation went well with no problems that I could see. We are still trying to make a time for the installer to come over and show us how to operate the system, particularly the monitoring system. I hope they will give us a tutorial or some advice about managing our power use to best take advantage of the solar system.

If anyone is looking at solar right now I'd highly recommend you talk to Andrew at https://www.solarbank.com.au/. Really knowledgeable and professional team - only slightly more expensive than the other 4 installers I spoke to, but the only one who really understood the issues and was addressing them correctly according to all the research I did. You get what you pay for... I don't often make recommendations, but he deserves as much business as he can get...

Mine was a tricky installation, but I'm very happy with the outcome.  Excellent customer service from quoting through to follow-up after installation to ensure everything was running smoothly.  The installation was completed within 3 weeks of my accepting the quote. We had a small issue with the app/wifi, which was resolved by resetting the system. Fantastic to be able to monitor my production and usage.
Mixed results,. Most gave prompt quotes. Only one firm gave a professional follow up.

Andrew and his team were total professionals.... from start to finish they kept us informed and discussed our requirements  for a solar system to suit our home and budget.We got a few quotes from other suppliers but decided on SolarBank because of the communication, quality of the inverter,  panels,  .... in addition we felt confident that Andrew and his team would be there for us should we have any issues.
The team at Solarbank did an amazing job.From sitting me down and understanding our energy usage and needs all the way to picking up every last cable stripping.Professionalism at its best!

We had a fantastic experience with Solarbank.  They organised an in person visit very promptly to check the site and determine the best size system, what was required for our specific installation.  The quote was not the lowest we received but we felt it was by far the most informed and the one which we thought was customised for us.  We were also most comfortable that the owner/installer was a direct local business rather than the 'sales/quote' being over the phone and then outsourced to an installer.  We had a new model of inverter installed and we there was an issue with it which we noticed a couple of days after installation.  Solarbank got back to us immediately and came out to our property on the weekend to inspect.  They quickly ascertained there was a manufacturer fault in the inverter itself and promptly swapped it out for a new unit.  We were kept completely informed every step of the way on what the issue was, what was being done to identify it and communicate with the manufacturer.  Our system has worked seamlessly since the faulty inverter was replaced.  it is the right size for our needs and we couldnt be happier.  We would not hesitate to recommend Solarbank as a local direct installer who know everything there is to know about solar power, will take the time to explain and will be genuinely determined to provide the best customer service and ensure you are happy with the result.

Quoting was honest and knowledgeable. More expensive than other quotes but I am comfortable it was worth the extra.Installation was very quick, competent and accommodating.  The team were punctual, capable and polite and left the house as it was before with no wiring offcuts etc nor packaging left behind.The installer walked me through the logging-on process so that i could see the monitoring immediately. Very impressive.

Andrew and his team delivered an extremely positive experience. From the initial quote, where Andrew took us through the options in a logical and considered manner, to the installation on the day, where we were clearly dealing with polite professionals who took you through all the steps and had great attention to detail, I highly recommend Solarbank. Robert, Cromer, NSW.
A pleasure to deal with, very professional.The result looks excellent, and service to connect to monitoring app very smooth

I have rated my experience with Solarbank Australia very highly for good reason. Throughout the process, from system design to commissioning, I dealt with the founder Andrew Moderer. Andrew listened to my concerns about installing a solar system for our home: "right-sizing" the system; dealing with effects of shade; how to deal with the 'controlled load' feed to our hot water tank; inverter & battery location remote from the metre box; how to see real time data of our energy consumption against solar production, battery operation and grid interaction; and finally, how to improve the aesthetic look of the panels located on the front of our home. Andrew made good suggestions which were reflected in a number of quoted options that I could easily compare and decide on a system that gave me confidence in the reliability and performance of the various components. Of the solar installer companies I dealt with, Andrew demonstrated a deeper knowledge and understanding of the Clean Energy Council Guidelines for grid-connected solar PV systems with storage allowing Solarbank to design a system that better suited our needs whilst still maintaining the CEC requirements. As far as the installation was concerned I found Solarbank’s quality of workmanship, cleanliness and care of working on my home first class. They even came across with a degree of pride in what they had achieved at the end of a day of hard work. I am only a couple of days into operation of the system and so far its fantastic! I highly recommend Solarbank Australia.

From our first contact with Andrew, Director from Solarbank to the completion of the installation, everything was undertaken professionally and without any hard sell. He personally came to our house, we had a thorough discussion on our needs, including system size, panel locations, and battery size. A proposal and comparison of options was then presented to us via email. We then further discussed the options to come to an agreed Solar System plan. Upon our agreed plan, a quote was sent through outlining all costings and terms including a return on investment analysis. A 25% deposit was paid upfront and an installation date agreed.There was no installation date slippage and the whole system, including panels, inverter, smart meter, battery system was completed in one day. The Solarbank team operate like a well oiled machine, they are polite, efficient and clean! Andrew also made sure our Fronius Solar Web account and tracking system and app were working so that we can track our system's performance.

Andrew met me on site for quoting process, so a big plus there. He was able to answer all my questions clearly and was very impressive. However, I was a little surprised that he had not asked about the existing gas hot water service, and it was only when I asked, after the quoting process, that he provided advice to replace it with an electric storage tank and add a Catchpower Green controller.Installation was quick (one day), and the guys were professional, polite, helpful and neat.Solarbank follow up after the install was prompt and they initiated the grid connection paperwork,Altogether, a great job guys!

Thank you Andrew  Tom Troy Angus and Chris.  The Installation went seamlessly and you were all a delight to have at my property. All questions answered and everything neat and tidy when you finished. I'm confident that I have a high quality system which will last me to the end of my days :)
Great experience, friendly team and worked with us to find the right solution for our home. Always did what they said they would, on time & on budget. I’d highly recommend Andrew & the SolarBank team

Great experience overall from Andrew and the team. Andrew came out to the house and walked us through the options with a customized solution for the property and our needs. The installation was completed in one day and on the day that we had agreed. The installation team were very friendly and cleaned up everything after the install was completed. Andrew monitored the system to ensure correct functioning and ensured we were connected to the app and understood how to use it. It's great to deal with such a professional team and I would highly recommend Solarbank.

Andrew and the team were great from start to finish.Communication was clear and forthcoming and Andrew provided straight forward answers to all my questions.Installation was quick, and efficient and they left the property tidy.

We were looking to install a fairly large system (15-16kw) plus a battery.We quoted with 4 separate companies (via Solar quotes).To be honest, they all came back within a few thousand of each other (not to say a few thousand dollars isn't important; but in the general scheme of things, there wasn't a major financial factor that swayed the vote)Our biggest concern / pain point was skill of the installers and the quality of the overall installation.I'll just jump to the point here - the crew that arrived from Solarbank were absolutely top tier; they were lovely guys, were well trained, respectful of our property, and were meticulous with the installation.If you want great quality hardware, installed with the care and precision - Solarbank were amazing.

Upon receiving three quotes on three different solutions and after reviewing a lot of helpful information from SolarQuotes articles, I concluded Andrew from Solarbank had the optimum solution for my property.The installation was carried on a date that I could be in attendance and with 50 years in the construction industry, I was very impressed with the install. An excellent experience on all fronts, a really good job.

Andrew from Solarbank was very helpful from the initial consulation right through to post installation at both educating on the best system for my situation and keeping me informed on progress. Very responsive and easy to deal with. Would highly recommend.

The entire process, from the initial quotation to the installation was incredibly smooth.Andrew demonstrated a genuine willingness to understand and accommodate my preferences.Installation day was hassle-free, the team was very professional, friendly, and efficient. They took the time to confirm the placement of everything and cooperated with me on the power shutdown. Everything was up and running in less than a day.So happy I chose Solarbank. I am very satisfied with the outcome and highly recommend Andrew and his team.
Very pleased with Andrew & Solarbank. Really appreciated the lack of high pressure sales tactics & informed approach. Installers were great & all went smoothly.

Andrew came to our house on time as he indicated he would, reviewed and discussed our requirements in a no frills way. everything he recomended was in plan english with no fancy up selling. we received several quotes and made the decision to go with Solarbank.Andrew also steered us in the right direction to engage an electrician as we needed to have modifications to our switchboard to allow for the upgrade of our electrical meter. in the end we decided to engage Solarbank for panels only at this stage which we willl review down the track and install a battery if need be. The installation took a day, the guys cleaned up after themselves, which is a bug bear of mine, the system was on line that afternoon generated power.Couldnt be happier with the job and would recomend Andrew and Solarbank to anyone looking to install Solar.
Very professional and knowledgeable. Cleaned up some minor damage to concrete on installation immediately. Highly recommend.

Andrew was great, answering every little question and ensuring understanding pre and post sale. The panels look great on the roof (we can hardly see them) and they seem to be doing what was expected. Great service and product
Andrew knows his stuff as does his crew. He supplied us a top line system and great advice. Puntual, everything went as planned with a very tidy outcome.

Solarbank are a professional company providing high quality solar systems. Andrew and his team made the process very easy and worked with respect, understanding and very customer focused. Andrew must be so proud of his team who delivered a quality system quickly. All workers have high knowledge of what they were doing. Very impressive and hghly recommended.
No fuss, no mess, no BS. Just a very professional attitude and service, its a pleasure to do business with Solarbank.

Sales quoting process was very efficient, details & questions that we had were explained clearly.Installation was a breeze, all installers were polite, efficient & the job was completed very professionally.Customer service is excellent - they organised grid connection & have been very prompt & professional with any follow up required.
Andrew was polite and veryhelpfulHis team are very goodIts only the first day after installAnd we look forward to great solar relationship

From our initial phone enquiry the company were professional, helpful and on the ball.  The installation process was punctual and seamless. The after install service has been second to none.  Would not hesitate in recommending this company.
Solarbank installed our solar paneling and I found Andrew and his team very professional and polite. I was very happy with the job they have done.

Very satisfied with the solar installation and would highly recommend Solarbank Australia. The sales/quotation process was conducted in a thorough and upfront way with all questions answered. The installation team were, on time, polite, and highly professional and went to an extra effort to wire the system internally. The customer service was excellent throughout the process with Solarbank contacting my electricity provider and distributor after the install.

This firm has been a delight to deal with.The quoting was professional, timely and the pricing attractive. There was no attempt to oversell and in fact, demonstrated I did not require as big a system as quoted by others.The installation was conducted in a single day, the installation team a delight to have on the premises. They were friendly, tidy, polite and kept me well informed as the work progressed. The power from the grid, naturally, had to be switched off temporarily - I was given plenty of notice and the interruption was very brief. The team arrived on site with a 10kw invertor although a 8kw was quoted. Rather than delay the installation Solarbank kindly installed the larger capacity unit at no cost to me. Co-ordination with my supply provider was included.The service post installation to sort a couple of niggles was undertaken cheerfully, promptly and efficiently.I am more than happy to recommend Andrew and his team to any prospective purchasers.Regards
Andrew from Solarbank came out to quote promptly. He talked us through the whole process. We decided to go ahead based on a friend's recommendation, price and their products.

Solarbank was excellent throughout the process, from initial quote through to installation and meter updates. He offered good advice and really thought about how best to maximise our system for a reasonably complex roof with north, east and west facing aspects.Communication was very good, Andrew was always easy to contact and responded quickly.Installation was effortless, a very experienced team who arrived on time, got everything up and running quickly and to a high standard, leaving the site as clean as they found it.

Quoting process was straight forward. In regards to value for money and quality of system, we are happy so far but time will tell.Installation was quick and efficient, staff polite and tidy.Andrew provided excellent customer service also with the grid connection.

Andrew and his crew have been calm, professional and helpful from first contact.I had some specific requirements, and these were all met in the quoted and installed system. No surprises on the day, no extra charges - what was installed is exactly what was proposed. Easy.The install crew was friendly, helpful, polite and cleaned up afterwards. Power shutoffs to the house were advised in advance. The work was neat and tidy, with no loose ends or shortcuts that I can identify.If you are wary of being given the run-around by sharp sales techniques from the big companies (and you are in the northern part of Sydney), then at least give Andrew a call.

From initial contact through to post-installation the experience with Solarbank was great.  Straightforward quoting process and the contract was in plain english.  The installation team was excellent, very professional, the site was left spotless and they provided clear communications throughout.  A pleasure to have on-site.  Highly recommend the Solarbank team.

I got several quotes, and chose to go with SolarBank due to the open and clear engagement I had with them.  Andrew has been fantastic before and after the install, highlighting the specific challenges with my property and how best to manage them. He and the team took the time to answer all of my questions and ensured I understand the system and what I was getting.  In the end, I've got an excellent system, with a very professional installation.  A friend had a similar install around the same time as me with one of the bigger players, but had a very different experience, both with the install and the system, not getting the same level of visibility into how his system is performing.

I would highly recommend Andrew and his team from Solarbank. From the start of the quoting process Andrew came across as very knowledgeable about solar. Any questions I had, he was able to answer. The installation was done within a day. They were punctual, polite and left the place tidy. Andrews customer service was exceptional. He helped organise everything. A great team to work with.
A seamless, timely and efficient process - from quote to installation was a pleasure to deal with Solarbank. Great job well done, thanks.

I shopped around for a bit and had a couple of solar installers in mind. Andrew from Solarbank ended up blowing me away with his knowledge and patience answering my many questions. He was able to come to my house pretty soon after we chatted on the phone and the initial install date he gave me was actually *too soon* as I had some work to get done before the install could go ahead. I was expecting to spend way more for a smaller system.In the end the install was trickier than expected due to the nature of my house but they got it done anyway and I am so happy with the results. I will definitely consider going back for a storage solution or a new install if I ever move house.
Easy from quote to finish.  Punctual, new exactly what they were doing. So happy with the end product and result.

Andrew was helpful and happy to discuss the pros and cons of various options during the quotation stage. The quote was accurate to what was discussed, and was comparable in price to other quotes I received.The install went smoothly - the guys turned up on time, were professional, and made sure I was happy with solutions to any issues they came across.Overall, a positive experience - would certainly use them if I was in the market for Solar again.

I called Andrew at Solarbank after he installed systems for both my Brother and Father. He was easy to deal with and quickly provided a quote, and when agreed scheduled in a date for install.The team arrived on-site exactly when they said, and went about completing a really high quality install. Everything needed was included - even re-terminating some cabling for the internet connectivity.I was assisted in getting the system online and understanding the shutdown procedure if needed. The phone app to view system performance was available to me on same day as installation. Communication with my provider was completed in my behalf. The team also took care of the warranty registration providing for 10 year coverage of the inverter.I highly recommend Andrew and the Solarbank team.

Quotation was detailed and informative,coupled with an efficient and trouble free installation.Customer contact was very professional,  grid connection and solar rebate was handled completely by Solarbank.I would highly recommend the Solarbank team.
A clear standout from beginning to end in terms of knowledge, aesthetics and attention to detail. Only recommends top quality panels and inverters. Very happy and highly recommended.

Andrew and his team were porfessional in every aspect of the installation - from inspection of the property before quoting to the actual install day and organising grid connection after, his attention to detail, service and friendly team are worth every dollar. If in Sydney, absolutely ensure you request a quote from the team.

The whole experience of dealing with Andrew and his team was straight forward and easy to manage. His advice has proved to be accurate and the system he installed is faultless. I can highly recommend this company.

The whole process was perfect, excellent explanation on the system prior to purchasing by Andrew, then installation was done so professionally by Paul and his team, could not fault any part of the process.
Andrew and his team did a great job on my solar system supply and install.Did what they said they were going to do, when they said they would do it.Highly recommended...!

My solar system was installed on 1 December 2022. My home in on the northern beaches.I was reasonably well read on home solar (beforehand) and had a number of solar quotes for my home.Solarbank was the only company that insisted on seeing my home before sending me a quote to ensure its accuracy.This meant a lot to me as they wanted to ensure the design would not leave any ugly architectural consequences (which can result from conduits over roofs / along external walls and placement of inverter etc.). These design aspects should not be overlooked.Their advice and recommendations were factually correct and this built trust with me from the outset.The install went well and the communication throughout the process was first class. I recommend Solarbank.Shane

Attention to our site detail was the difference between Solarbank and the rest. Our long driveway and battle-axe block was closely considered for the inverter capacity for feedback into the grid. Our bills were analysed and a payback period was identified of 3.9 years. Layout of panels on our roof was advised after a site visit taking into account even our chimney position for shading. A slight change was accommodated to the solar panel layout to allow access to the roof. The system was delivered on time with a tidy installation too. The crew were great.

Andrew from Solarbank was excellent , quick to quote, pragmatic advice and quick to follow up with answers to questions.  Had a few follow up queries post installation and again, quick helpful responses.Highly recommend.

I got 4 quotes for 10kW 25x solar panels, string inverter & roof tile mount installation.  All were prompt and I had quotes with a week. Two were very similar in price and product, the other two varied, one higher, one lower.   I went with the best price/performance option and the one that made me feel most comfortable with my decision.After an initial washout their team took a chance on another wet day. With an early start they were in and out in 4.5hrs, they went over & above, ie removed my Foxtel dish & took it away and sorted an slight unrelated cabling issue on the roof for me.  Cleaned up after themselves nicely and kept me well informed throughout the morning. Made sure I had the monitoring software on my laptop & phone and explained how to use it, coached me on how to got the right outcome from my installation & energy provider in the future. I didn't have to lift a finger for grid connection apart from signing the certificates with my finger :-)

Andrew from Solarbank was polite, tidy and punctual.  His quote, was clear and comprehensive.  He kept us informed  the whole time and was able to explain why he had suggested things in a clear and easily understood manner.  He supervised the work on the day - which was very soon after we'd agreed to go ahead.  All the workers here on the day were polite and easy to deal with (especially as we had to make some changes to our electrical system at the same time.)   The whole process was really satisfactory and simple.  Highly recommended.

Everything was done very professionally, on time and on budget.Owner very good to deal with.Referees were also overwhelmingly positive.Your website however, along with Choice Magazine articles,  was most helpful in " getting my head around " the whole solar issue( s) --of which there are many.Bring on cheaper, more powerful batteries in 3 or 4 years time!
